title: The Zscaler Python SDK against ZPA: where its behavior is described

prose.text: Method tables are generated: run `node scripts/kb.mjs surface <query>` for a module's methods and the endpoints they call. These subjects hold the client behavior around them; the API contract itself is in [[zpa.api]].

prose.label: Client.
prose.text: Credentials, tenant ID and environment variables are in [[zpa.sdk-python.client-configuration]], and the microtenant parameter in [[zpa.sdk-python.microtenant-scoping]]. Which base path each method uses is in [[zpa.sdk-python.endpoint-versions]]. Return values are in [[zpa.sdk-python.return-shapes]], errors in [[zpa.sdk-python.error-handling]], paging in [[zpa.sdk-python.pagination]], and retries in [[zpa.sdk-python.retries-and-rate-limits]].

prose.label: Helpers.
prose.text: How ID lists become nested objects is in [[zpa.sdk-python.id-list-reformatting]]. Application segments: [[zpa.sdk-python.application-segment-helpers]] and [[zpa.sdk-python.browser-access-modules]]. App Connector groups and schedules: [[zpa.sdk-python.connector-helpers]]. Provisioning keys: [[zpa.sdk-python.provisioning-keys]]. Policy: [[zpa.sdk-python.policy-helpers]] and [[zpa.sdk-python.policy-groups]]. Log receivers: [[zpa.sdk-python.lss-helpers]]. Client-side validation: [[zpa.sdk-python.validation-helpers]]. Controllers whose names mislead: [[zpa.sdk-python.small-controllers]].

prose.label: Go SDK.
prose.text: Go SDK service functions that return partial results, send wrong keys or reject valid input are in [[zpa.sdk-go.service-defects]].
